title: Start: Discord message
description: Starts the work for each Discord message the bot can read. Connects out to Discord, so no tunnel or open port is needed. Messages sent while the work was off are skipped.

fields.name: bot_token
fields.label: Bot token
fields.help: Developer Portal > Bot. Message Content Intent must be on. Usually comes from the Discord bot credential set.

fields.name: channel_ids
fields.label: Only these channel IDs (space or comma separated)

fields.name: only_mentions
fields.label: Only messages that mention the bot (and DMs)
